answer: For a poll on a walnut grove by the lagoon, the server checks each ballot for a valid yes or no choice and rejects invalid ballots. It approves a signal tower only if more than two-thirds of valid ballots say yes. If 100 honest ballots say no, an attacker needs at least 201 yes ballots, costing submission effort. Fake ballots can still win, and the threshold can block popular proposals.
